requirement: Saga state reader initialization: the reader requires Wolverine's database-backed message store and throws InvalidOperationException when the injected store is not database-backed, because it needs the store's schema and data source to read saga rows.

preconditions.text: A SagaStateReader is constructed with an IMessageStore

returns.text: A database-backed store is captured; a non-database-backed store is rejected

exception_text: InvalidOperationException when the message store is not database-backed
